scenes.say: Trilobyte turns any floor plan into measured rooms, material quantities and today's prices.
scenes.text: Trilobyte turns any floor plan into measured rooms, material quantities and today's prices.

scenes.say: A site manager has one question: how much concrete do I order for this floor? Today that takes hours with a scale ruler, a spreadsheet and calls to suppliers.
scenes.text: A site manager has one question: how much concrete do I order for this floor? Today that takes hours with a scale ruler, a spreadsheet and calls to suppliers.

scenes.say: Drop in a plan. A phone scan, a PDF, a CAD file or a BIM model.
scenes.text: Drop in a plan. A phone scan, a PDF, a CAD file or a BIM model.

scenes.say: Trilobyte finds the walls, rooms, doors and windows, reads the scale from printed areas or door widths, and measures every room.
scenes.text: Trilobyte finds the walls, rooms, doors and windows, reads the scale from printed areas or door widths, and measures every room.

scenes.say: The common questions are ready before you ask. Concrete for this floor: twenty four point three cubic metres, about forty seven hundred euros, and every room it counted is marked on the plan.
scenes.text: The common questions are ready before you ask. Concrete for this floor: 24.3 m³, about €4,700, and every room it counted is marked on the plan.

scenes.say: Prices are live. The context dot dev API searches Finnish supplier pages for concrete, levelling compound, flooring, plasterboard, paint and skirting, and each price links to its source.
scenes.text: Prices are live. The context.dev API searches Finnish supplier pages for concrete, levelling compound, flooring, plasterboard, paint and skirting, and each price links to its source.

scenes.say: Click a room to price it on its own. Change the slab thickness or waste, and every quantity updates.
scenes.text: Click a room to price it on its own. Change the slab thickness or waste, and every quantity updates.

scenes.say: Or ask in plain language. Laminate for the four kitchens: forty one point seven square metres, seven hundred and ninety euros.
scenes.text: Or ask in plain language. Laminate for the four kitchens: 41.7 m², €790.

scenes.say: Distance and area tools measure anything else, right on the sheet.
scenes.text: Distance and area tools measure anything else, right on the sheet.

scenes.say: And every plan becomes a three D model you can orbit.
scenes.text: And every plan becomes a 3D model you can orbit.

scenes.say: On CAD and BIM drawings the geometry is exact. On held-out test drawings, area answers were right ninety nine point eight five percent of the time. On scans, the scale is estimated and flagged for a check. Other questions go to a small vision model we fine-tuned on Verda GPUs, for under two cents per thousand questions.
scenes.text: On CAD and BIM drawings the geometry is exact. On held-out test drawings, area answers were right 99.85% of the time. On scans, the scale is estimated and flagged for a check. Other questions go to a small vision model we fine-tuned on Verda GPUs, for under 2 cents per 1,000 questions.

scenes.say: Trilobyte. From drawing to order list in a minute, with the evidence on the sheet.
